system: Compose a visible monumental Venusian quarry. Return only the complete .scene program, without Markdown, reasoning or commentary.
prompt_template:
Write a free architectural composition for this brief:
{brief}
The main visible landmark must be one box named "{landmark}".
Copy the following fixed header EXACTLY, then append 8 to 20 box directives:
room "Eryx local composition"
camera eye(0,1.7,-10) target(0,2,8) up(0,1,0) fov(55)
sky zenith(0.12) horizon(0.35) nadir(0.02) band(0.3) curve(1.5) noise(0)
distant_light direction(-0.6,-1,0.35) intensity(2.5) color(1,0.92,0.72) angular_radius(0)
spotlight panel(1,1) offset(0,0,0.35) range(40) cone(20,60) intensity(100)
plane "desert_floor" pos(0,0,10) normal(0,1,0) size(100,100) gray(0.3)

Only box "unique_ascii_name" pos(x,y,z) size(width,height,depth) rot(rx,ry,rz) gray(g).
rot is optional (Euler degrees, X then Y then Z). No other directives or properties.
Metres; Y is up, +Z is forward from the camera, X is lateral. pos is the CENTRE;
size is the FULL positive dimension, not a half extent. gray must be in [0.05,0.85].
Compose mostly within x[-18,18], z[-5,35], y[0,24]. Use substantial simple volumes.
Keep the eye outside all solids and the foreground open. Show the named landmark.
Make holes by assembling separate posts and a lintel, never a box filling the hole.
The supplied ground is flat at y=0; evoke a quarry cut through banks above it.
Keep masses supported by the ground or another mass; no floating decoration.
Syntax-only examples, NOT a complete level or a recipe to copy:
box "example_post" pos(-4,2,8) size(1,4,1) gray(0.4)
box "example_oblique_slab" pos(5,1,12) size(0.5,2,3) rot(0,25,0) gray(0.55)
No prefabs, emit, extra planes, annotations, ellipses, or trailing explanation.
Finish all directives within the output budget. Output the header and your boxes now.
repair_prefix: One full correction is allowed. Return the complete corrected program including the unchanged header. Preserve the brief and general composition. Change only the faulty objects; copy every unaffected directive exactly. When a foreground blocker hides the landmark, move or resize that blocker and keep the landmark unchanged. Dimensions are FULL extents: the whole solid must clear the reserved route, not only its centre. Fix these measured problems:
exploration_briefs: A colossal abandoned extraction block fills most of the view, yet its base opens through one small entry at human scale. Beyond that entry the interior must read as a genuine empty void, not a painted face: the mass spans overhead while the opening remains narrow and deep. Keep the surrounding site bare and monumental. Place one box named "portal" inside the visible opening so it reads as a fixed datum against the dark emptiness.

A narrow open-air passage runs between two immense quarry banks of unequal height. Their walls sit firmly on the ground; leave a generous visible gap between them. A solid survey datum named "portal" stands beyond the passage against the open sky. The place should feel compressed and asymmetrical, without a roof.

A low abandoned shelter rests against a massive quarry wall. Its broad roof is supported by separate thick posts; the entrance remains visibly open. A freestanding upright survey marker named "portal" stands beside the entrance. Leave the approach empty and make the difference between human scale and geological scale unmistakable.

A sparse Venusian plateau has three widely spaced monumental grounded slabs. Their different heights and oblique angles reveal a distant upright survey marker named "portal" through a broad gap. Keep the horizon open, with a few low grounded remnants and no roof or floating masses.

An abandoned stepped quarry court descends visually between banks raised above the supplied flat ground. Low terraces butt against a high rear retaining wall; keep a broad central open floor. A grounded survey datum named "portal" stands prominently in the court. All terraces and walls must have clear solid support.
